name: Golden bellapple
desc: Golden bellapple (Passiflora laurifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Passiflora laurifolia, commonly known as the water lemon, Jamaican honeysuckle, golden bellapple, pomme liane on Martinique & Guadeloupe and orange lilikoi, is a species in the family Passifloraceae.
